resources.description: feed-in-profile for rooftop photovoltaic power plant nearly Erfurt (middle), Nordhausen (north), Gera (east) and Hildburghausen (swest); The feed-in profiles are based on weather data for a typical year from Meteonorm version 7.3.4.21143. The irradiation was taken directly from Meteonorm at module level. An angle of incidence of XX° was assumed. The irradiation was further processed in PV-Lib {1}. The XXX module and the XXX inverter were used to calculate the feed-in profiles. The rooftop feed-in profiles were ultimately standardised to 950 full utilisation hours. The data was collected in the ZO.RRO II project by Nordhausen University of Applied Science.
